title: feat(service-storage): rename an attachment by the delete rule, and the Attachments tab names other people's uploads
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3T2gwH6MWTYde4qF8edEDN)_

Fixes #35724
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：记录页「附件」页签里，别人上传的文件现在显示上传者姓名（读者有权查看该用户时）；能删除附件的人，在自己上传的文件上（若还能编辑附件，则在所有文件上），每行「⋮」菜单在「删除」旁多了「重命名」，改名后刷新仍保留。
- 为什么做：附件页签改为紧凑行之后，上传者一栏对他人文件一直是空的，菜单也缺少原卡片要求的重命名（附件页签紧凑行改版的后续）。
- 出错会怎样：上传者一栏最坏仍是空白，绝不显示用户编号；重命名只改附件在该记录上的显示名，不动文件本身，误改可以再改回，撤回本变更即恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Rulings (quoted from the card): "The attachments read the panel uses returns the uploader's display name (an expand of `uploaded_by`, or a name field the server stamps), shaped by the reader's existing user-read rights, and no wider." and "Add a rename route on the attachment service (same permission as Delete: uploader or parent editor), and a Rename item in the row ⋮ menu that calls it."

- **Uploader, expanded through the reader's own read.** No name column is stamped. Both reads the panel uses now expand `uploaded_by`, the way the activity stream already expands `actor_id`: the record page payload's `attachments` part (`packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.ts`, the producer of the panel's first read, so the fix lands there rather than in `service-storage`) and the panel's own list read (`$expand: ['uploaded_by']`). The expansion is the engine's `$expand` sub-read of `sys_user` as the caller (CRUD gate, row scope, field security), so a reader who may read the uploader gets the user row and its `name`, and a reader who may not keeps the stored id, which the panel never renders. The spec's stream table (`record-page.zod.ts` JSDoc, prose only, restating the ruling) and its generated reference page say so.
- **Rename door.** `PATCH /api/v1/attachments/:id` with exactly `{ "file_name" }`, mounted beside the uploader's removal door at the same route (`attachment-removal-routes.ts`, a ledger row per door). It reads the row as the caller (`404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` for an unreadable or unknown id), then writes by the delete rule's two limbs without restating it: the uploader is renamed under a system context attributed to them, as the removal door removes (no edit grant needed), and anyone else's rename runs as the caller through the engine, so the object's edit grant and the attachment update gate (whose `authorizeRows` is the same function the delete gate runs) decide. A caller who reads the record but cannot edit it gets the update gate's `403 RECORD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`. Only `sys_attachment.file_name` changes; `sys_file` is untouched.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/permissions/attachments-access.mdx` gains a rename-door section (who may rename, the edit grant, the uploader's self-rename, the 400/401/403/404 answers) and an enforcement-summary row.
- **Affordance map.** `@object-ui/core`'s affordance-to-grant map gains the row `attachmentRename` (`crud: null`, grant `update`), with its expectation in the census test `affordanceGrantMap-12082`. The panel asks this row for the edit-grant half of Rename, because the census refuses a CRUD grant read outside the map.
- **Panel.** The row ⋮ menu offers Rename behind the delete grant (`canDelete`), following the rename door's two limbs (`canRename`, seat ruling in rework): on the caller's own uploads, and on every row to a reader who also holds the edit grant on `sys_attachment`. It opens a name prompt; Save is disabled for a blank or unchanged name; a refused rename keeps the dialog open with the rule in words. Four new i18n keys in all eleven locale packs.

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-removal-routes.ts` — `renameAttachment`: the owner comparison is the only thing that admits the elevated write.
2. `packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.ts` — `answerAttachments` now expands `uploaded_by` (wire change for that part's rows).
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx` — `handleRename` and `AttachmentRenameDialog`.

## Tests

All runs on the tree of `78e903181`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0).

- `@objectstack/service-storage`: full `pnpm test`, 87/87 files, 1708 passed, 1 skipped. `typecheck` exit 0. New pins in `attachment-removal-routes.integration.test.ts` run against a real ObjectQL on in-memory sqlite with `StorageServicePlugin`:
  - the uploader with no edit grant renames (200; the name is trimmed and stored; `sys_file` untouched);
  - a parent editor renames another user's upload (200);
  - an editor without the edit grant renaming another user's upload gets 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`; a reader who is not an editor gets 403 `RECORD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`;
  - a caller who cannot read the record, and an unknown id, get 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`; anonymous gets 401; bad bodies and any query parameter get 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`;
  - a reader of the uploader reads `uploaded_by` as `{ id, name }`; a reader refused `sys_user` keeps the bare id and gets no name.
  - The route-ledger conformance test now enumerates both doors.
- `@objectstack/rest`: `pnpm test --project local`, 427 files, 8776 passed, 351 skipped. `typecheck` exit 0. `record-page-routes.test.ts` pins the attachments part's read with `uploaded_by` expanded.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`: the four attachments-panel test files plus the i18n tests, 110 files, 2039 passed, 13 skipped. New pins:
  - the panel's list read expands `uploaded_by`; an expanded row shows the uploader's name; a bare-id row shows no id, no name and no title;
  - Rename sends a PATCH with the trimmed name and shows the stored name; a 403 keeps the dialog open with the rule in words; a blank or unchanged name leaves Save disabled;
  - with no delete grant there is no Rename; with the delete grant but no edit grant, the menu is Download, Delete attachment; with both, it is Download, Rename, Delete attachment.
- Rework round 2: the uploader holding delete but not edit sees Rename on their own row and no Rename on another's row. This is pinned for a bare-id `uploaded_by` and for an expanded one; delete+edit sees Rename on every row, and no delete grant means no Rename. Panel tests at `6582d7525`: 4 files, 63 tests, under the lock (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- Final head `f4edf7037` (after merging main and adding the map row), under the lock (VERDICT command-exit 0):
  - UI: the four attachments-panel files, the affordance-map census `affordanceGrantMap-12082`, core `affordanceGrant-35684` and the i18n tests passed, 112 files, 2098 passed, 13 skipped.
  - service-storage: the rename-door integration test and the route-ledger conformance test passed, 2 files, 19 tests.
  - rest: `record-page-routes.test.ts` passed, 37/37.
  - Run alone, the census file also passed, 55/55.

<details><summary>Ablations (each one: mutate with scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, run, restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

1. The uploader's elevated write removed (`row[ownerField] === callerId` replaced by `false`). The first run stayed green, 15/15: the fixture had no edit-grant stand-in, so that reading is void. After adding the edit-grant stand-in and the no-grant uploader pin, it went red: 1 failed, 15 passed (16), on "the uploader renames their own attachment with no edit grant". Restored, blob `43dbe9a9e46e`.
2. The record page's `expand: relationMap(['uploaded_by'])` removed: `record-page-routes.test.ts` red, 1 failed, 36 passed (37). Restored, blob `f91616543c2e`.
3. The panel's `$expand: ['uploaded_by']` removed: `RecordAttachmentsPanel.test.tsx` red, 1 failed, 45 passed (46), on "the list read expands the uploader". The first attempt ran no tests because the `@objectstack/client` dist was missing, so that reading is void; it was rerun after building the client. Restored, blob `0b11778a08b5`.
4. Rename offered without the `canDelete` guard: `affordanceGrant-12047` red, 3 failed, 5 passed (8). Restored, blob `0b11778a08b5`.
5. Rework, at `927ff8061`: Rename gated on the delete grant alone (`canRename = canDelete`). `affordanceGrant-12047` went red, 1 failed, 8 passed (9), on "a reader who may delete but holds no edit grant sees Delete and no Rename". Restored, blob `930fe40d0cfe`. The first attempt at this ablation was void: the fresh worktree had no `@objectstack/spec` dist, so no tests ran. It was rerun after building the `@objectstack/client...` closure. (Superseded by round 2's gate.)
6. Rework round 2, at `6582d7525` and again at the final head `f4edf7037` (same reading both times): the uploader limb of `canRename` removed (`return !!callerId && uploaderId === callerId;` replaced by `return false;`). `affordanceGrant-12047` went red, 2 failed, 8 passed (10), on both uploader pins (bare-id and expanded). Restored, blob `c269fef686b4`, with `git diff HEAD` empty.

No ablation test file is kept.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing spot outside the claimed surface.** The panel's first read is the record page payload, and that payload is produced in `packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.ts`, not in `service-storage`. The expand is added at that producer, with its test pin. Other files outside the claim, all following from that:
  - the spec's JSDoc prose in `packages/spec/src/api/record-page.zod.ts` (prose only, restating the ruling; no Zod shape changes);
  - its generated reference page `content/docs/references/api/record-page.mdx`;
  - the tenant-audit write census for `service-storage` (one new write call site, decidable as `sys_attachment`);
  - the dogfood record-page streams test, which now asserts the expanded uploader.
- **Refusal code.** A reader who is not an editor gets the update gate's standard `403 RECORD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, not the delete gate's `ATTACHMENT_DELETE_DENIED`. A new verb takes the standard code.
- **Deviations.**
  - **The UI gates Rename by the rename door's two limbs**, beyond the card's wording "a reader who may delete". Behind the delete grant, Rename is offered on the caller's own uploads, and on every row to a reader who also holds the edit grant. This matches the server exactly: the door renames an uploader's own attachment with no edit grant, and writes anyone else's rename as the caller, which needs the edit grant. So the gate changes no permission; it only stops offering a door the server refuses. This is a seat ruling (f7-text relay, rounds 1 and 2).
  - **Two files outside the claim surface were touched to clear that census:** `ui/packages/core/src/utils/affordanceGrants.ts` (the new row) and `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` (its expectation). `@object-ui/core` is added to the changeset as a patch.
  - **The docs paragraph** on the rename door is added in this PR (`content/docs/permissions/attachments-access.mdx`).
- **"No name and no id."** A reader refused `sys_user` gets the stored bare id back from the server, which is the engine's ADR-0104 stored form. The panel never renders it: no name, no id, no title. The pin asserts what the panel renders.
- **What a rename changes.** Only `sys_attachment.file_name`. The stored `sys_file`, its bytes, and the file name a download carries are unchanged. That a download keeps the original name is noted here and not filed.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run src/attachment-removal-routes.integration.test.ts` — expect 16 passed: the uploader and a parent editor rename (200, name stored, file untouched), a reader-not-editor gets 403 `RECORD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`, an outsider 404, anonymous 401, malformed requests 400; an attachment read expands the uploader for a reader of that user and keeps the bare id for one refused it.

Local subset only; CI runs the full set. Rework at `927ff8061`: the derived gate list is unchanged (126 families). The docs families, check:nul-bytes, check:cross-package-test-inputs, check:i18n-stale-fill, check:test-source-alias and spec check:docs were rerun: all exit 0 except spec check:skill-examples, which exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no spec declarations in the fresh worktree) and is NOT MEASURED for the rework. It had exited 0 at `78e903181`, and the rework does not touch spec or skills.

Rework round 2: Build & E2E UI was red on `927ff8061` (job 137217115981). That was not a size regression and not this PR's change: `check:eager-closure` refused because main had moved `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS` (`ui-components` 451100 -> 445144) after the branch's base, and the gate's log reads "NOTHING GREW" (measured `ui-components` 344.5 KB against a 440.5 KB ceiling). The fix named by the gate was applied: `origin/main` (`85a995452`) was merged in, and no ceiling was touched. Post-merge local gates all exited 0: tenant-audit-census, check:test-source-alias, check:route-envelope, check:i18n-stale-fill, check:nul-bytes, check:doc-anchors and check:cross-package-test-inputs. The docs families on `6582d7525` all exited 0, and overlap-check was clean. The eager-closure gate itself needs the full UI build and is left to CI.

Test UI (15/16) was red on `927ff8061` (job 137217116142). This one was this PR's: the round-1 panel read the edit grant with a direct `perms.can('sys_attachment','update')`. The census test `affordanceGrantMap-12082` ("no console source outside the map reads a CRUD grant on its own") listed `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`, the only failure in 442 files. The fix is the `attachmentRename` map row read through `resolveAffordance`; no OUT_OF_FAMILY entry was added and no test was skipped. That red CI run is the before-leg; the after-leg is the census passing at `f4edf7037`.

- The `--commands` derived gate list was run at `1bc31906e` (103 commands), and the 22 families added by later commits plus every earlier failure were rerun at `78e903181`. Exit codes are in the report.
- NOT MEASURED locally, for these reasons:
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n`: their prerequisite builds are absent (exit 3);
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: shallow clone (exit 3);
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check: the ui dist is not built, so it reports 1986 "Cannot find module '@object-ui/*'" errors before reaching any check;
  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` and the dogfood suite: not run.
- CI's Type Check UI, Test Core and dogfood jobs cover these.
